title: character@5
description: character@5 = character@4 carried in full plus (all optional, docs/proposals/EQUIPMENT.md 7.1): derive, equipment entries hand (main/off) and count, weapon_proficiencies, armor_proficiencies. character@4 -> character@5 is an identity migration with derive absent (= false). Integers only (4.3).

features.description: Class/race features. Effects are mechanically active (see schema description); never bake their numbers into actions.

equipment.description: Bare strings are the descriptive @3 entries (never loaded). {item, equipped?, value_gp?} objects reference an item@1 document by content id and are live (docs/proposals/VERSION_BUMP_BATCH.md 10).

value_gp.description: Value in gp of this entry, default 0. A priced material (spell@1 components.m with cost_cp and item) is provided by the first equipment entry whose id equals components.m.item exactly and whose value_gp * 100 >= cost_cp (docs/CONTENT_CONVENTIONS.md section 7). Such an entry needs no item@1 document.

forward_compat.description: Opt-in flags for engine features that are not implemented yet (elevation, T&C-G12). Descriptive and ignored by sim; listed with the inert mechanics. New enum values widen the @4 schemas additively.

inert_mechanics.description: Mechanics the document carries but the engine must ignore (e.g. 'reactions', 'bonus_actions', 'equipment', 'damage[1..]'). Written by the 3->4 migration; a hand-written @4 file may carry it too.

no_breath.description: R-G11 creature fact (CONTENT_CONVENTIONS 4.6), default false: the character doesn't need to breathe (Stinking Cloud's automatic success with auto_success_no_breath); maps to Combatant::no_breath. Reserved: the sim archetype loader (engine/core/sim/src/content.cpp, Engine Core) does not read it yet, so the validator warns and it has no effect until then.

shapechanger.description: R-G11 creature fact (CONTENT_CONVENTIONS 4.6), default false: the character is a shapechanger (Moonbeam's shapechanger_disadvantage); maps to Combatant::shapechanger. Reserved: the sim archetype loader (engine/core/sim/src/content.cpp, Engine Core) does not read it yet, so the validator warns and it has no effect until then.

evil.description: R-G11 creature fact (CONTENT_CONVENTIONS 4.6), default false: the character is evil for zone rows (Spirit Guardians' evil_damage_type); maps to Combatant::evil. Reserved: the sim archetype loader (engine/core/sim/src/content.cpp, Engine Core) does not read it yet, so the validator warns and it has no effect until then.

derive.description: Default false: printed AC / to-hit / damage are used as written. true: they are derived and asserted (EQUIPMENT 5.6).
